info.name: Crochet Mood Cozy - Olive & Latte
info.description: A cozy crochet-inspired YouTube theme featuring warm olive green, soft coffee brown, beige and cream colors. Designed for a relaxing cottagecore atmosphere with comfortable contrast and eye-friendly tones.
info.additionalInfo: Transform YouTube into a warm and cozy space inspired by crochet, cottagecore and earthy tones. This theme combines olive green, light coffee brown, beige and cream colors to create a relaxing viewing experience. Perfect for users who prefer soft, eye-friendly colors instead of the default dark theme.
